children: (“Vita Coco” or the “Company”), a leading high-growth platform of better-for-you beverage brands, today announced that the Company will participate in the Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference on September 16, 2026, in Nashville, TN.

Martin Roper, Chief Executive Officer; Corey Baker, Chief Financial Officer; and Charles Van Es, Chief Commercial Officer, will participate in an in-person fireside chat on Wednesday, September 16, 2026, at 9:30 a.m. Central Time (10:30 a.m. Eastern Time). The live webcast of the fireside chat will be accessible in the “Events” section of the Company’s Investor Relations website at
. An archived replay of the webcast will be available shortly after the live events have concluded.

The Vita Coco Company is a family of brands on a mission to reimagine what’s possible when brands deliver healthy, nutritious, and great tasting products that are better for consumers and better for the world. This includes its flagship coconut water brand Vita Coco, and Copra, a super-premium brand that specializes in Thai Nam Hom coconut water. The Company was co-founded in 2004 by Michael Kirban and Ira Liran and is a public benefit corporation and Certified B Corporation. Vita Coco, the principal brand within the Company’s portfolio, is the leading coconut water brand in the U.S. With electrolytes, nutrients, and vitamins, coconut water has become a top beverage choice among consumers after a workout, in smoothies, as a cocktail mixer, after a night out, and more.

title: The Vita Coco Company to Participate in the Piper Sandler Growth Frontiers Conference
